name: VERTICAL AUTOCLAVE WITH SLIDE LOCK
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS INNO-LXAU-160 is a highly advanced, fully automatic vertical autoclave engineered to deliver precise sterilization for demanding laboratory environments. Distinguished by its electronic double inner slide locks and an eight-column evenly distributed interlocking device, it offers rapid and effortless loading.
features: 'Inspiration' Fast Speed Microcomputer Controller with 20 memory cycles
Flip Open Type lid with 8-Column Interlock and Electric Double Inner Locks
Automatic Internal Discharge with 2 Embedded Steam Collectors
Preset Auto-Start timer up to 6 Days in Advance

specifications.Pre-Programmed Cycles: Liquid, Liquid w/ Warming, Solid, Wrapped Instrument, Fabric, Rubber, Fast, Waste, Agar Melting
specifications.Timer Function: Preset Auto-Start up to 6 Days in Advance
specifications.Door Locking Mechanism: Flip Open Type, 8-Column Interlock, Electric Double Inner Locks
specifications.Exhaust System: Automatic Internal Discharge with 2 Embedded Steam Collectors (6 selectable speeds)
specifications.Baskets Supplied: Stainless Steel Baskets (2 or 3 depending on model)
specifications.Standard Safety Features: Lid Closing Check, Dry Scorch Protection, Overpressure Valve, Water Level Sensor, Over Current/Leakage Protection, Anti-Scald Chamber Cover
